response.overview: The story follows a charming con artist who makes a living by seducing wealthy, single women to seize control of their fortunes. Using his smooth-talking tricks, he targets a very wealthy woman as his next mark. However, she lives with her sharp-witted 7-year-old daughter. To pull off his scam and get his hands on the money, the man must first win over the little girl. But as he spends time with them, the pure-hearted mother and daughter deeply impact his life, challenging his fraudulent ways and forcing him to reconsider his life of lies.
response.title: Хөөрхөн ээжтэй охин
